note: Orchard Harvest (mixed add/subtract within 10). English only. Type A = pick the sign (a*_q question, a*_r equation feedback); type B = pick the sentence (b*_q); type C = pick the number (c*_q). Runtime shuffles the ten questions.

lines.text: Look! Three apples on the tree.
Two more apples fly in. Now, we have more. Let's add!
Three plus two equals five.
Oh no! A strong wind is blowing.
Two apples fall down and roll away. Now, we have less. Let's take away!
Five minus two equals three.
When we add, numbers go up.
When we take away, numbers go down.
Four dogs, and three more run here. Do we add or take away?
Four plus three equals seven.
Six birds, and two fly away. Do we add or take away?
Six minus two equals four.
Five rabbits, and four more hop in. Do we add or take away?
Five plus four equals nine.
Seven fish, and three swim away. Do we add or take away?
Seven minus three equals four.
Look at the balloons. Which number sentence matches this?
Look at the birds. Which number sentence matches this?
Look at the apples. Which number sentence matches this?
Eight apples on the tree. Three fall down. How many are left?
Five apples on the tree. Four more grow. How many apples now?
Six apples on the tree. Two more grow. How many apples now?
